annotation.title_clean: ISO 23793-1:2024 Intelligent transport systems — Minimal risk manoeuvre (MRM) for automated driving — Part 1: Framework, straight-stop and in-lane stop
annotation.title_en: ISO 23793-1:2024 Intelligent transport systems — Minimal risk manoeuvre (MRM) for automated driving — Part 1: Framework, straight-stop and in-lane stop
annotation.summary_en: ISO 23793-1:2024 is an international standard from ISO/TC 204 setting minimum requirements for minimal risk manoeuvres by automated driving systems (Level 3-5) in light-duty vehicles. It defines a classification framework and control strategy and test procedures for straight-stop and in-lane stop. This is a catalogue page.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines classification framework and concept of operation for minimal risk manoeuvres (MRM)
Specifies control strategy and test procedures for straight stop (type 1) and in-lane stop (type 2)
Applies to light-duty vehicles with Level 3-5 automated driving systems
Excludes failure detection, MRM initiation decisions, and ISO 26262/21448 design requirements
